liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Loser** (2 reviews): Reviewer says the show got going with this song; Every verse was flubbed, and Jerry's guitar was turned down cautiously in the mix [5][13]
- **Space** (1 review, 1 other source): Reviewer finds the space particularly inspiring, calling it the climax of the show; Uploader says the post-Space portion makes the highlight reel [1][14]
- **Brokedown Palace** (2 reviews): Jerry fumbled a line in this song, amusing even him; reviewer links it to altitude; Reviewer says it stumbles but is beautiful as an encore [8][12]
- **Hell in a Bucket** (1 review): Reviewer considers this solid opener the peak of the show [13]
- **Sugaree** (1 review): Reviewer loves the groove here, with wailing Garcia guitar [12]
- **When I Paint My Masterpiece** (1 review): Bobby won over the crowd with a heartfelt delivery of this Dylan song [5]
- **Bird Song** (1 review): Reviewer found some very inspired moments in this song [6]
- **Here Comes Sunshine** (1 review): Flubbed right from the start [7]

## The recordings

- **gd1994-12-01.141192.FOB.Schoeps.Clark.Miller.Noel.t-flac1648** (recommended): source not stated; 18 songs; 181 min; rated 1.5/5 by 2 [1]
- **gd94-12-01.aud.ladner.10932.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 18 songs; 171 min; rated 1.78/5 by 9 [2]. Said about its sound: Reviewer says this audience recording sounds awful, as though taped in a bathroom [11]
- **gd1994-12-01.138024.mgUM70S.graves.flac1648**: source not stated; 18 songs; 172 min [3]

## Around the show

- Reviewer says Jerry made a similar slip in Brokedown Palace at Telluride in 1987 [8]
- Reviewer calls it the weakest show of the Denver run and the last in Colorado [13]
- Uploader disputes comparing the Brokedown Palace here to the Telluride one [1]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1994-12-01.141192.FOB.Schoeps.Clark.Miller.Noel.t-flac1648**: taped by Greg Clark; transferred by Charlie Miller and Joe Noel; source: flac16/48kHz ; Master Dat Recording by Greg Clark: (FOB) Schoeps MK41 > Dat (Panasonic SV-255/48k); Transfer info: Dat > Panasonic SV-3700 > Tascam DA-3000 >… [1]
- **gd94-12-01.aud.ladner.10932.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Paul B. and Chris L.; source: Audience: Unknown Mics [2]
- **gd1994-12-01.138024.mgUM70S.graves.flac1648**: taped by unknown; transferred by Bill Graves; source: flac16/48kHz ; Source: Microtech Gefell UM70S Cards > Teac P-20 > DA-P1; [3]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Michael Mullen Grateful Dead: [1994-11-29 McNichols Sports Arena, Denver, CO, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1994-11-29-mcnichols-sports-arena-denver-co-usa/) [16]
- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead McNichols Sports Arena - December 1, 1994](https://www.dead.net/show/december-1-1994) [17]
- Poster by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Backstage Pass - McNichols Sports Arena](https://www.dead.net/archives/1994/clippings/backstage-pass-mcnichols-sports-arena) [18]
